biotools.summary: SMTrackR is an R/Bioconductor package for visualizing and quantifying protein-DNA binding states on single sequenced DNA molecules using techniques like NOMe-seq, dSMF, and Nanopore. It queries a single-molecule footprint database and provides heatmap visualizations categorized by binding states.
